data.name: Migrating Herd
data.description: When you summon an aurochs, bison, elephant, horse, mastodon, pony, or similar quadruped herbivore with a summoning spell, the duration of the spell is increased by 100%% (this does not stack with Extend Spell). The creature's land speed is increased by 10 feet.
